info.name: PeoplePay360 - Backend API Tests
info.description: Full request collection for the PeoplePay360 HR & Payroll backend (NestJS). Import directly into Requestly via 'Import from Postman'. Covers Auth, Users, Employees, Departments, Contracts, Working Schedules, Attendance, Time Off, Salary Structures/Rules, Payruns, Payslips, and Dashboard endpoints, matching PeoplePay360_Backend_Guide.md.

request.description: Returns accessToken, refreshToken, user. Test sets {{accessToken}} via a post-response script.
Server returns 409 OVERLAPPING_CONTRACT if this employee already has a RUNNING contract covering the period.
Used internally by the Payroll Engine to resolve the applicable contract for a payroll date.
totalWeeklyHours is computed server-side from lines, never accepted from the client.
Returns 422 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE if the type requires allocation and remaining balance is too low.
Transactional: decrements matching TimeOffAllocation.remaining and increments .taken.
Used by the frontend's live rule editor for inline validation before saving.
Returns eligible employees WITHOUT creating anything.
Only fires on explicit Create Payrun click - creates Payrun + one Payslip per selected employee.
202 Accepted - enqueues a compute-payslip BullMQ job per payslip; status -> COMPUTING.
400 if unresolved blocking warnings exist across payslips.
Only allowed from VALIDATED status; payslips become immutable after this.
Only allowed while parent Payrun is not PAID.
